body_markdown:
It’s beginning to look a lot like Christmas on the Great American Family channel—and you get to enjoy every single moment (and movie!) for FREE throughout November. That means you can cozy down with heartwarming stories filled with family, faith, fresh starts, and holiday traditions.


Great American Christmas kicked off in October and is still underway with holiday movies airing around the clock and new original premieres every weekend. There are 18 new options airing between October and December on this popular channel, so it’s time to prep your favorite spot on the couch and get watching.


November’s lineup features familiar faces including Candace Cameron Bure, Danica McKellar, Mario Lopez, Tony Danza, Cameron Mathison, Ryan Paevey and more. Here are the new movies to watch during the free preview.


#### ****


#### **Nov. 7–8: Second chances and a return home**


- **Karen Kingsbury’s *The Christmas Ring*** — Saturday, Nov. 7 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
Jana Kramer, Benjamin Hollingsworth and Kelsey Grammer star in a story about a military widow searching for a treasured family ring. Her quest leads her to a widowed antiques dealer and opens the door to healing and a second chance at love.


*Hot tip: this is the second Karen Kingsbury movie on Great American Family. Last year’s was called Somone Like You and starred Sarah Fisher, Jake Allyn, Lynn Collins, Scott Reeves, Robyn Lively, and Bart Johnson. Keep an eye on the schedule or use your TDS TV+ Search to see if this is airing in November!*


- ***An Ozark Mountain Christmas*** — Sunday, Nov. 8 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
A young designer reluctantly returns to the Ozarks, where her family’s legacy and a caring local man help her rediscover faith, purpose and the meaning of home. The film stars Brianna Cohen and Jonathan Stoddard.


#### **Nov. 14–15: Saying yes to new beginnings**


- ***The Christmas Yes List*** — Saturday, Nov. 14 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
Great American Family favorites Danica McKellar and Sam Page lead this holiday romance about a lifelong people-pleaser who comes home determined to finally say “yes” to herself.
- ***Christmas at Moose Lake*** — Sunday, Nov. 15 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
After a breakup brings Alyssa home for Christmas, a misplaced engagement ring and an unexpected connection help her find the courage to begin again. Britt Robertson, Ryan Paevey, Natasha Henstridge and Kevin Dillon star.


#### **Nov. 21–22: Family traditions take center stage**


- ***Three Generations, One Christmas*** — Saturday, Nov. 21 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
Mario Lopez, Tony Danza, Taylor Kalupa, Dominic Lopez and Courtney Lopez come together in this multigenerational story about a family fighting for the future of its beloved supper club.
- ***Letters This Christmas*** — Sunday, Nov. 22 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
A struggling Christmas novelist returns home in search of inspiration. Reconnecting with her family, treasured traditions and first love may help her rediscover the story she was meant to write. Ashley Newbrough and Jesse Hutch star.


#### **Nov. 27–29: A holiday weekend full of romance and rescues**


- ***A Sweet Christmas Anniversary*** — Friday, Nov. 27 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
Candace Cameron Bure and Cameron Mathison return as Sophie and Sam. While celebrating their first anniversary in a storybook Christmas town, the couple is drawn into a royal mystery that tests their love and renews their appreciation for the season.


*Hot tip: this is the third installment of the Sweet Christmas film franchise. The rest of the schedule isn’t available yet, but this author is willing to bet the earlier movies will also be replayed, so keep an eye out if you missed them the first time.*


- ***A Christmas Rescue*** — Saturday, Nov. 28 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
A devoted doctor and a visiting veterinarian join forces for a Christmas pet adoption event. As they work to find homes for rescue animals, they may find a home for their own hearts, too. The movie stars Trevor Donovan and Stephanie Bennett.
- ***The Greatest Christmas Gift*** — Sunday, Nov. 29 at 8 p.m. ET/PT
When an unexpected setback threatens Emma and Caleb’s Christmas wedding, they learn that the season’s greatest gifts can be found in faith, selfless love, and a community that keeps believing. Danica McKellar and Matthew Marsden star.


#### **Be sure to look out for the new October movies, too!**


The network premiered four new movies in October, and they will surely be playing all season long.


- ***A Second Chance Christmas*** with Candace Cameron Bure and Johnathan Scarfe
- ***Silver Bells at Christmas*** starring Laura Osnes and Ryan McPartlin, Chuck Wicks and Taylor Kalupa
- ***A Christmas Prayer Tradition*** starring Shae Robins and Christopher Russell
- ***A Very Arctic Christmas*** starring Jill Wagner and Cameron Mathison


*Hop tip: use the Search in your TDS TV+ menu to find viewing options for the ones you missed!*


#### **Make November movie night month**


Whether you love small-town homecomings, family legacies, Christmas mysteries or stories of hope and second chances, Great American Family has a movie for your holiday watchlist. Your free preview lasts all of November, so be sure to tune in—and if you like what you see, go online or give us a call to get Great American Family all year long!
